texts: Single ventricle physiology is the one option the book does not count as a risk factor for mortality on VA-ECMO: D.
The book lists age under one month, male gender, a long period of mechanical ventilation before support and hepatic dysfunction.
Prolonged ventilation before ECMO reflects lung injury and delay, and hepatic dysfunction reflects end-organ damage from low output.
Single-ventricle patients do carry a higher mortality in several registry reports, so the point is debated.
In the picture, the single-engine-room hotel keeps its gills humming with no coffin of its own.
Memory hook: four signs stand by the coffins; the single engine room stands apart.
